To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Glu-Nat symport and NCX activity in astrocytic processes can generate stable Ca2+ oscillatory activity in astrocytes.
astrocytic Glutamate uptake and the Na+/ Ca2+ exchanger are the key players in the generation of spontaneous Ca2+ transients in astrocytic processes.
astrocytic Glutamate transporters and Na+/Ca2+-exchanger (NCX), together with synaptic Glutamate release, are essential for the signaling function of the tri-partite synapse.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel aspect of tripartite synapses: the interdependence between synaptic and astrocytic compartments.
the role of astrocytic Na+ in the regulation of Ca2+ dynamics.
the role of astrocytic EAAT and NCX in synaptic Glu clearance and Ca2+ regulation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

astrocytic Glutamate-Na+ cotransport is essential for the generation of astroglial Ca2+ signals in the leaflet microdomain, and that NCX activity alone may generate spontaneous Ca2+ waves in the astrocyte.
Glu-Nax+ symport is a key factor in the generation of Ca2+ signals in the astrocyte leaflet microdomain, and NCX activity alone may generate stable, spontaneous Ca oscillation.
astrocytic Glutamate-Na+ symporter is a key component in the tripartite signalling of the synapse.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tripartite synaptic architecture is an essential element for the generation of astroglial Ca2+ oscillatory signalling, which is critical for the functional integration of synaptic information.
astrocytic Glutamate transporters and NCX activity are both important for the generation of spontaneous Ca2+ transients.
astrocyte-mediated Ca2+ signalling is not only dependent upon synaptic activity, but is also an inherent property of the astrocyte itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Glu-Nax symport is essential for the signalling role of the tripartitic synapse and intrinsic NCX activity generates spontaneous astrocytic Ca+ oscillations.
Glu-Nac symport, NCX and the extent of astrocyte coverage are key parameters for the generation of astroglial Ca2+ oscillatory activity.

Glu-Naxymport and NCX activity in astrocytic leaflets are essential for the signalling function of synapses and may play a prominent, yet overlooked role in the generation and regulation of astrocytic calcium oscillations.
